bug.title: The null permutation shuffles each symbol's returns in time, so a null target can be a return already inside the signal's own lookback, and planted nulls score as discoveries
bug.symptoms:
nulloracle.blockpermute.block_permute_cross_section permutes each symbol's own forward-return series in contiguous 20-day blocks, using one seed for all symbols. For symbols present throughout, that is a whole-row block swap.
With 92 dates there are about 5 blocks. Whenever a block lands one block earlier, the "forward return" served on date d is a return from up to 20 days before d. Any signal whose lookback covers those days, such as 20-day momentum, already contains that return, so it correlates with its own null target. That is look-ahead in reverse.
Measured on the real snapshot, 20-day momentum scores |t|>1.96 against the null on 34% of seeds, with mean t +1.56. Other signals get an under-dispersed null (20-day vol: t sd 0.34), which makes nulls distinguishable from reals. The KS guard then voids the campaign, and the planted nulls become the campaign's top discoveries. Every calibration figure (FDR_deploy, sensitivity, specificity, KS) is invalid until this is fixed.
bug.reproduction_steps: Build a {date: {symbol: forward 1-day return}} panel over 92 consecutive dates from a trending synthetic market. Then: 1. Compute a 20-day momentum score per date from the same prices. 2. For seeds 1..200, compute the Spearman IC t-stat of the scores against block_permute_cross_section(panel, seed=s, block_days=20). The mean t is far from 0, and P(|t|>1.96) is far above 0.05. On the real snapshot, see the table in this spec's header comment.
bug.expected: - block_permute_cross_section keeps its name, signature, determinism under (seed, block_days), and refusals. It becomes a cross-sectional block shuffle. - Each date d's permuted row is a derangement of d's own forward returns over d's own cross-section. Every value comes from date d, so no value from any other date can reach d. - The symbol mapping is drawn once per contiguous block of block_days dates from the seed and the block index, so each assigned series keeps its within-block autocorrelation and volatility clustering (PRD §4.1, §7.2). Within a block, dates with an identical cross-section use the identical mapping. - Where membership changes inside a block, a derangement is re-drawn deterministically for that date's cross-section. - The output's membership equals the input's on every date, so gate_targets still accepts it. - A date with fewer than two symbols is passed through unchanged, since it cannot be deranged. The module docstring states this rule and explains why time-block shuffles leak. - block_permute (the bare-series function) is unchanged. - The response shape for null and real nodes stays identical. Nothing outside the scorer learns null status. - test_null_time_leak.py covers: - On a seeded synthetic trending panel (92 dates, 40 symbols, block_days 20) over 200 seeds: - a 20-day momentum signal has a null t mean within ±0.35 and P(|t|>1.96) ≤ 0.09 - a 20-day volatility signal has a null t sd within [0.7, 1.3] - a 5-day reversal signal behaves likewise - Every permuted value on date d is one of d's own values; no symbol keeps its own value. - Determinism under the seed. - The mapping is constant within a block whose membership is constant. - Membership changes are handled: a mid-window listing and a delisting. - A one-symbol date passes through unchanged. It passes under pytest-xdist and runs in under 20 s. - The existing tests that pin the time-shuffle's values are updated to the new mechanism, and their intent is kept: - test_null_permutation_cross_section.py: "always-present symbols equal the old algorithm" becomes "equal the documented cross-sectional mapping" - test_snapshot_targets.py and test_target_route.py, if they pin permuted values Membership, determinism and refusal tests stay as they are. - The nulloracle, orchestrator and api member suites pass, and so does the root tests/ suite, including tests/e2e/test_planted_null_ks_guard.py.
bug.actual: Root cause: the permutation moves values across time within each symbol, so a null target can come from inside the signal's information set. A cross-sectional derangement within each date cannot.
bug.constraints: The sidecar format, perm_seed/block_days storage and all callers are unchanged; only the panel function's mechanism changes No file outside the five listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
